messages:
Maya: Hey team — PR #2387 (migration guide + SDK snippet) preview on Netlify failed CI twice with a build timeout. Local `mkdocs serve` works fine, so not sure if it's assets or a build step.
Maya: Netlify shows 20m build timeout, but logs stop at the `npm run build:docs` step.
Liam: Can you paste the failing log snippet?
Maya: Sure — relevant tail:```
> build:docs
> npx mkdocs build --clean
INFO: Building documentation to site/
ERROR: ENOSPC: write, not enough space in /tmp
Build failed after 12m
```
Jules: ENOSPC during Netlify builds usually means the container ran out of disk during the plugin step (we had a similar one in oct). Could be large artifact from the migration examples.
Priya: Is the PR adding a big binary or an example dataset?
Maya: Just a couple JSON examples (2.5MB total) and a screenshot (1.8MB). I can compress the screenshot but worried about CI still hitting container limits.
Liam: Two options: 1) reduce asset size in the PR (compress, use SVG for diagrams), or 2) switch this preview to Vercel for faster builds — but that needs a branch-level config.
NetlifyBot: Preview deploy failed for PR #2387 — build terminated (exit code 1). Link: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/abc123
Dave: For quick unblock: Maya, can you push a temp commit that removes the screenshot and see if preview completes? If yes we isolate asset size.
Maya: Will try. Pushing now.
Maya: (after push) NetlifyBot: New deploy queued...
NetlifyBot: Deploy succeeded: preview deploy-ready — https://deploy-preview-2387--redwood-docs.netlify.app/ :tada:
Maya: Ok result looks good without screenshot. So we likely hit disk limit. I'll replace screenshot with an optimized SVG and move the large JSON examples to the repo's `examples/` dir and load them via link.
Jules: Sounds good. Also add a quick note in the PR description about preview flakiness + local steps so reviewers know how to repro.
Priya: FYI — for local dev I use:```
pip install mkdocs-material==8.1.0
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
# or with node-based tooling
npm ci && npm run docs:dev
```
Priya: That avoids Netlify env quirks.
Liam: Reviewers — can we get two approvals after the asset change? I'm juggling a release merge slot later today (18:00 PT). If this can be merged before 17:30 I'll include it in the docs batch.
Maya: @Liam noted. I'll aim to have the compressed assets up in the next 20m.
Dave: I can give a quick content review once assets are in. Jules can do the technical/snippet check.
Jules: I'll look at the SDK snippet (Rust->TS migration) too. Quick tip — wrap the snippet in a fenced block with language tag so mkdocs highlights:```rust
let client = Redwood::new();
```
Maya: Uploaded compressed screenshot + moved large JSON to /examples and updated links. Pushed.
NetlifyBot: New deploy started for PR #2387.
NetlifyBot: Deploy succeeded: https://deploy-preview-2387--redwood-docs.netlify.app/
Jules: Quick pass done — snippet formatting and links look good. One small nit on phrasing in the migration note.
Dave: Content LGTM.
Priya: Local dev instructions added to PR description. Tested `mkdocs build` locally, passing.
Liam: Approved. @Jules can you approve so we have two?
Jules: Approved :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all — merging now during merge window (16:45 PT).
Liam: Thanks — I'll watch the release merge slot.
NetlifyBot: PR #2387 merged by Maya.
Maya: Follow-up: I'll open a small RFC about keeping example assets under 1MB for Netlify preview stability. Short checklist in the RFC to include compression + examples hosting.
Dave: Good idea. Saves reviewer time.
Maya: Closing thread — feel free to ping if preview flake recurs. :wave:
